statement: Remove copied Quest evidence verification readers and failure-bundle pass-through export chains so the canonical source/scripts and test duplication ratchets pass at or below their existing limits. Preserve verification approval/refusal, the public failure-bundle writer, diagnostic behavior, and each consumed binding's original defining owner.

constraints.statement: Scope: scripts/quest-evidence verification readers and one shared reader; failure-bundle harness aggregate exports and their actual consumers, including current failure-bundle tests; existing verification/harness tests; only necessary generated owner/test metadata and measured downward ratchet updates. Do not change product src, runtime diagnostics algorithms or unify same-named functions with distinct owners.

Keep CLI flags, output meaning, refusal/exit behavior, existing stronger content-bound verification, raw logs and evidence provenance. Preserve failure-bundle function bodies and imported binding identities through the extraction. Do not remove assertions or selected tests to obtain a pass.

Use the actual canonical duplication scanner and test runner. No raised baselines, ignored clone files, detector/config changes, fabricated receipts, mock benchmark results or comparative campaigns. Test controls remain isolated unit-test fixtures, not systems measurements.

This bounded repair closes duplication debt only. Retry the exact-HEAD publisher after reviewed landing, retain any further refusal, and keep broader Q8/physical/release acceptance under their existing owners. Historical records remain append-only.
